blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines—University of Santo Tomas big man Collins Akowe remained determined after his team’s frustrating loss to University of the Philippines in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament. Rather than dwell on what could have been against UP in the 103-101 double overtime loss on Wednesday, Akowe is urging UST to learn from the defeat and move forward. “We’ll go back to the drawing board. It’s a loss but we don’t take it as a loss, we take it as a lesson,” Akowe told the Inquirer. “We gave them a good […]...
